title: One Little Push
premise: The black cat on the fence pushes one flowerpot off. It hits a rake, which fires a hose, which sprays the dog through the laundry line. The dog comes out wearing a frilly dress. The cat never moves.
visual: Backyard aftermath. A shaggy dog tangled in the laundry line wearing a pink frilly dress, a sock on its tail and underpants on its head. A spraying hose, a flipped rake, a broken flowerpot. On the fence, the black cat sits with one paw still out.
characterLean: Black cat callback: the cat is the silent witness and never changes expression. This is the one time it causes something.

motion: 6-8s. Paw tap. Pot falls. Rake flips. Hose fires. Dog sprints through the laundry. Dog sits, proudly dressed. Cat slowly lowers the paw.
notes: Chain should take under 4 seconds so it fits the loop. The dog loves the dress. The cat's face is the same in every frame.
